summary: Captures reusable Python/openpyxl patterns for Excel processing tasks. Key lessons: (1) Use venv creation when encountering PEP 668 externally-managed-environment errors rather than system pip or --break-system-packages, (2) Handle mixed date types (datetime objects vs strings) when reading Excel, (3) Evaluate formula cells manually using constants from reference sheets rather than relying on data_only=True which returns None for unsaved formulas, (4) Create new workbooks for output rather than modifying inputs in-place.
